title: The Ugly Duckling
summary: A very different young child must leave his home and walk far away.
coverScene: A large and unique duckling looks at his reflection in the water while white swans swim nearby on a bright spring day.

sentences.text: On a warm summer day, a farm welcomed new animals.
One unusual bird came from a large egg.
He looked very different because he was big, gray, and strange.
Everyone noticed his appearance right away.
The farm was a busy place for all the animals.
Many things lived around the old red building.
The sun gave bright light upon the green land.
Every day brought new times for the young farm animals.
The mother bird had waited a long time for her family.
She felt glad to see the little ones running about the yard.
However, this new bird did not look like the others.
He was much bigger than his brothers and sisters.
His body had a strange color that people spoke about.
The farmer looked at him with a strange expression.
No one had ever seen such a strange animal on this farm before.
The days were long and full of bright light.
Little did the bird know about the hard times ahead.
Because he looked unlike the rest, other animals began to bother him.
The little bird was frequently hit and pushed around.
Even his mother grew tired and wished he would leave.
Feeling completely blue, the poor young bird decided to go away from the farm.
He walked far until the warm season turned into a long, hard, and cold winter.
The weather became freezing, and food grew very low.
He had to survive all on his own through the deep snow.
It was a difficult time, but he kept going through the terrible season.
The wind blew cold air across the white fields every night.
He searched everywhere for something small to eat.
Sometimes he found nothing for days and days.
His legs grew weak from walking through the heavy snow.
He missed the comfort of the farm and his mother care.
Yet, he kept moving forward because he wanted to live.
The cold days tested his strength in every possible way.
He hoped that tomorrow might bring better weather and some food.
When spring arrived, the warm sun made the ice go away.
The bird swam out onto the lake and saw white birds.
He looked at their beauty, wishing that he could be like them.
Expecting to be sent away, he slowly put his head down.
However, when he looked down at the water, he received a huge surprise.
He had grown up, and he was no longer a strange bird.
Instead, he had become a beautiful white bird.
The other birds welcomed him warmly, and he was very glad.
He swam across the clear water with his new family.
The sun warmed his body as he moved well.
He realized that his hard life was finally over.
A bright future stood before him on the blue lake.
All the trouble of the past winter disappeared completely.
He sang a quiet song of joy to the spring morning.
The other birds stayed close to him throughout the day.
He had finally found a place where he truly belonged.

sentences.text: On a warm summer day, a little farm welcomed several new animals into the world.
Among them, one unusual bird came from a large egg.
He looked very different from the other children because he was big and quite strange.
Everyone on the farm noticed his strange appearance right away.
Because he looked unlike the rest, the other animals began to bother him constantly.
The little bird was frequently hit and pushed around by his brothers and sisters.
Even his mother grew tired of the constant trouble and wished he would just go away.
Feeling completely sad, the poor bird decided to leave the farm behind.
He wandered far across the land until autumn turned into a long, hard, and cold winter.
The weather became freezing, and food grew very low for the single traveler.
He had to survive all on his own through the deep snow and bitter winds.
It was a difficult time, but he managed to live through the terrible season.
Every single day brought new challenges, yet he kept moving forward through the snow.
He had no friends to help him when the night became dark and cold.
The wind blew fiercely around his tiny body while he searched for something to eat.
Many hours passed slowly as he tried to keep warm under the trees.
He often thought about his old home and wondered if life would ever improve.
The harsh weather tested his strength more than he had ever expected before.
Still, he refused to give up hope because he wanted to live.
Months went by slowly until the freezing air finally started to change into something milder.
When spring finally arrived, the warm sun made the ice water soft across the lake.
The beautiful bird swam out onto the water and saw a group of wonderful white birds moving nearby.
He admired their beauty, wishing that he could be like them.
Expecting to be chased away because of his ugly look, he sadly bent his head down.
However, when he looked down at his own reflection in the water, he received a huge surprise.
He had grown up, and he was no longer a strange bird.
Instead, he had transformed into a beautiful bird himself.
The other lovely birds welcomed him warmly into their group, and he was happier than he ever dared to dream.
He stayed with them day after day, and his new life was full of joy.
The people on the farm never saw him again, but he finally found his true home.
He swam near the edge of the water and watched his new friends play.
They accepted him without any questions about his past or his appearance.
His heart felt light and free as he moved smoothly across the blue surface.
Every moment spent with the group brought him peace that he had never known before.
The sun shone brightly upon the lake, making the water sparkle like silver.
He felt proud of the journey that had brought him to this wonderful place.
Nothing could take away the happiness that now filled his daily life.
He knew that his difficult days were finally over for good.
The other birds shared food with him and taught him how to dive for fish.
Life by the lake was everything that he had ever hoped to find.
Every single morning brought a new reason to smile as he swam across the blue water.
His family far away could never imagine how well things turned out for him.
Winter came and went again, but he was strong enough to face any cold wind.
Spring returned with more warm sun and bright flowers along the edge of the lake.
Other animals often stopped by to watch the wonderful white birds play in the water.
No one could remember the strange little creature that had left the farm so long ago.
He was now a proud and strong member of the group, loved by everyone around him.
His heart was full of quiet, and he knew that he would never feel sad again.
Years passed quietly as he lived a long and calm life with his new friends.
Whenever the sun went down, they rested together under the bright evening sky.
The seasons continued to change, bringing new flowers and green leaves each year.
He watched the young birds learn how to swim and fly across the open sky.
Sometimes visitors from nearby towns walked along the shore to admire the beautiful scene.
They pointed at the white birds and spoke about how graceful the creatures looked.
He heard their kind words and felt a deep sense of pride inside his chest.
His old life on the farm felt like a distant dream from another lifetime.
He had grown strong and wise through all the experiences that he had survived.
The lake became a safe haven where peace and friendship ruled every single day.
He shared many quiet afternoons resting beside the water with his closest companions.
Their company made every hour special and full of quiet joy.
It was a happy ending for the bird who had survived such a difficult beginning.
He often thought about the past, but those bad memories had lost their power over him.
Life by the water was everything that he had ever wanted or hoped for.
The warm summer days returned each year, bringing new joy and continuous freedom.
He swam proudly day after day, showing his great beauty to the world.
Nothing could ever take away the quiet that he had finally found.
His story became a wonderful memory shared among the birds living by the lake.
And so, the beautiful creature lived happily for the rest of his days.
The wind whispered softly through the trees while the sun set behind the hills.
He closed his eyes and thanked the world for the wonderful life he now had.
No trouble could ever reach him here in this peaceful home by the water.
He was surrounded by love and friendship that would last forever.
The other birds gathered around him as night fell across the calm lake.
They rested together in complete safety, knowing tomorrow would bring more beauty.
His heart remained full of gratitude for the wonderful turn his life had taken.
The farm where he suffered was just a faded memory in his mind.
He was a new creature now, strong and proud in every way possible.
The story of his journey lived on among those who knew him best.
He smiled as he drifted peacefully into a deep and restful sleep.
And so the beautiful bird found his true place in the world at last.
